name: mywebshift-local-tests
description: Ferramentas locais de teste do MyWebShift (Firestore Rules e Functions Emulator)

scripts.test:integration: NFS_E_REGIAO=us-central1 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-mywebshift "node --test functions/test/integration.emulator.js"
